other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant should be studying at a recognized university in India or abroad

Applicant should be in the 3rd or 4th year (final or pre‑final year) of a Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Communications, Telecommunication, Radio, Information Technology, Computers, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline and have secured at least 60% marks
Applicant may have completed the Bachelor's degree in the last year with at least 60% marks
Applicant may have completed a Post‑Graduate/Master's degree in the specified disciplines in the last year with at least 60% marks
Qualifications may be relaxed in deserving cases based on TEC's needs, as recommended by the Selection Committee and approved by the Head of TEC
benefits_summary: Interns receive a monthly stipend of ₹15,000 and a certificate upon completion.
documents_required: Scanned copy of the duly filled Application Form (Annexure‑II) in PDF format
